Claim 1 (Currently amended):  
1. A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents include at least one unique identifier for each creditor.

Claim 2 (Currently amended):  
2. The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the bankruptcy documents are customized based on the requirements of each of the different bankruptcy organizations.

Claim 6 (Currently amended):  
6. A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the proofs of claims include at least one unique identifier for each creditor.

Claim 7 (Currently amended):  
7. The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are customized based on the requirements of each of the different bankruptcy organizations. 

Claim 8 (Currently amended):  
8. The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy, and wherein the messages include a unique identifier for each creditor.

Claim 11 (Currently amended):  
11. The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, and wherein the batch filing is performed in compliance with the specific requirements of each bankruptcy organization. 

Claim 12 (Currently amended):  
12. The method of claim 6 further comprising: generating a report; and sending the report to a particular creditor, wherein the report includes details of the filed proofs of claims and their status.

Claim 17 (Currently amended):  
17. The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record, wherein the validation includes checking for completeness and accuracy of the data record prior to generating the proofs of claims.
